obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your case file

results.segment: Your appointment about your case file with Grantley Legal Aid is booked for 17 February 2027 at 5.30pm.
Please allow for roadworks on the approach.

obligations.ask: Arrive promptly and bring the completed consent form

results.segment: Please arrive promptly, and bring the completed consent form with you when you come in.
Please take a ticket from the machine as you come in.
Please allow extra time if you are travelling by bus, and make a note of the dates you were away before you attend.
If the date no longer suits you, our reception team can offer another.
The next inspection is due in 18 months and we will arrange it.
